score.description: Whole number 0-20 (NOT 0-100) for the strength of this application against this advertisement, in a normal field. The app multiplies it by five for display, and may cap it; it shows both values.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences: what is strong, what is weak, and what a recruiter would actually do with it

level.description: Too senior for the level of the WORK — a way to be screened out that nobody tells you about. Not about credential height.

note.description: Why, in one sentence: salary mismatch, expected to leave, or the work would bore them
